name: Ryan Seacrest
current_role: Host of Wheel of Fortune (since Sept 2024); host of American Idol and Dick Clark's New Year's Rockin' Eve; founder, Ryan Seacrest Productions
profile: Atlanta-born TV/radio host and producer. Rose to fame hosting American Idol from 2002, built Ryan Seacrest Productions (Keeping Up with the Kardashians, Jamie Oliver's Food Revolution), co-hosted Live with Kelly and Ryan (2017-23) and replaced Pat Sajak as Wheel of Fortune host in 2024. Also investor in Typo keyboard and Pathwater.
interesting_fact: His Ryan Seacrest Foundation (launched 2010) builds 'Seacrest Studios' broadcast media centers inside children's hospitals - fourteen so far, from Atlanta to Utah.
deep_cut_fact: At 16 he won an internship at Atlanta's WSTR, where Tom Sullivan trained him; when a regular DJ called in sick, Sullivan put him on air - his first broadcast - and he then got the weekend overnight shift.
notes: Media personality rather than an energy/tech entrepreneur; foundation contact form is the published route. Also an investor in Pathwater (refillable aluminum-bottle water).

name: Lady Annabel Goldsmith
profile: English socialite and author, eponym of Annabel's nightclub in Mayfair; died 18 October 2025 (born 11 June 1934).
notes: Deceased 18 Oct 2025 per Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lady_Annabel_Goldsmith). Rich-list entry was shared with her son Lord (Zac) Goldsmith. Rest skipped per instructions.

name: Sun Taoran
current_role: Founder and major shareholder of Lakala Payment (300773.SZ); founded it in 2005 as chairman and president
profile: Peking University economics graduate (1991) and serial entrepreneur: co-founded BlueFocus (China's first listed PR firm) in 1996, led the launch of the Business Pocket (商务通) PDA at Hengji Weiye, then founded payments firm Lakala in 2005 with Lenovo and Lei Jun as backers. Lakala is now pushing an 'AI First' strategy and a planned Hong Kong H-share listing.
interesting_fact: As VP of Hengji Weiye from 1998 he led the launch of the 商务通 handheld, which reportedly held over 70% of China's PDA market in 1999-2001.
deep_cut_fact: After graduating from Peking University in 1991 he turned down his state-assigned job, joined Sida Group, rose from deputy manager of its ad department to GM of Sida Advertising within three years, and ran the computer magazine 《电脑时代周刊》 with a newspaper.

public_contacts.value: https://ir.p5w.net (Lakala investor interaction platform, used for its earnings calls)

notes: Lakala's 2026 IR events were fronted by director/GM Wang Guoqiang and board secretary Tang Hui, not Sun; his exact current board title was not confirmed. contact@lakala.com is the company mailbox listed in the 2024 annual report.

name: Shirley Hill
current_role: Founder of InterArch, the architecture and branding firm behind Commerce Bank and Metro Bank's branch design (wife of Metro Bank founder Vernon Hill)
profile: Founder of InterArch, the design and branding firm responsible for the look of Commerce Bank (US) and Metro Bank (UK), both founded by her husband Vernon Hill. Listed jointly with him on the Sunday Times Rich List (finance). Metro Bank moved its design work to other suppliers by end-2020.
interesting_fact: InterArch created the branding for both Commerce Bank and Metro Bank, the 'retail-style' banks known for long hours and in-person 'stores'.
deep_cut_fact: The Hills gave $10 million for the Vernon and Shirley Hill Pavilion at the University of Pennsylvania School of Veterinary Medicine; their foundation is one of the largest supporters of veterinary causes.
notes: No independent profile or published contact found; no recent source on her status, so alive marked unknown. Best route is likely via Vernon Hill's business offices. Avoid the InterArch/Metro related-party contract topic (governance controversy).

name: Zhou Shaoning (Shao-Ning Johnny Chou)
current_role: Founder, chairman and CEO of BEST Inc. (Hangzhou logistics group), taken private in March 2025 by a consortium including him
profile: Telecom and tech veteran who founded Hangzhou-based supply-chain and express-delivery group BEST Inc. in 2007 after running Google's Greater China business (2005-06) and UTStarcom China (1996-2005). BEST listed on the NYSE in 2017 and was taken private in March 2025 by a buyer group led by Chou.
interesting_fact: Before founding BEST he was Google's global VP and Greater China president, responsible for its sales and marketing in the region in 2005-2006.
deep_cut_fact: He spent a decade (1986-96) as director of wireless software and system development at AT&T Bell Laboratories, after studying computer science at Fudan (1978-80) and earning degrees from City College of New York, Princeton (MS engineering science) and Rutgers (MBA).
notes: Rich list name 'Zhou Shaoning' = Johnny Chou of BEST (百世). BEST went private 7 Mar 2025 (https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/best-inc-announces-completion-of-going-private-transaction-302395536.html), so the IR mailbox may no longer be monitored. Strong fit for a logistics/tech angle.

name: Wu Xiong
current_role: Listed as director of Biostime Pharmaceuticals (China) Ltd. and general manager of Hainan Fangsheng Industry Development Co. (per MarketScreener); former non-executive director of Health and Happiness (H&H) International Holdings (HK:1112)
profile: Early shareholder in the Biostime (合生元) infant-nutrition business founded by Luo Fei, now Health and Happiness (H&H) International Holdings, listed in Hong Kong in 2010. Aggregator data show him as an H&H non-executive director from May 2010 to March 2018; earlier he was GM of Hainan Junjie Automobile Sale Co. (2000-09).
interesting_fact: Before his involvement with the Biostime baby-formula and probiotics group, aggregator data list him as general manager of a Hainan car dealership, Hainan Junjie Automobile Sale Co., from 2000 to 2009.
notes: Low public profile. The 2010 Biostime prospectus names a 吳熊 holding 26.0% of Biostime Pharmaceuticals alongside Luo Fei (28.15%) and Luo Yun; that is likely the same person but was not confirmed (https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2010/1203/ltn20101203042_c.pdf). Facts come from aggregator (MarketScreener) data only.
